versions.content: Role of SystemSignal in inter-ECU client server communi- cation over Ethernet with clients located on different ECUs In case of a n:1 inter- ECU client server communication over Ethernet with clients located on different ECUs exactly one SystemSignal per communication direction shall be used to define the client server interaction between the server and all clients since the relationship be- tween the call and return is achieved by means of meta data items attached to the Pdu s by the Socket Adapter.
